brief:
An Israeli drone strike killed a Palestinian and wounded others Friday west of Khan Younis, according to Shehab Wire. The unmanned aircraft targeted a person walking near al-Faluja tower on a road in the area, located in the southern Gaza Strip.

The strike marked another in a series of Israeli aerial operations across Gaza. Emergency and medical services responded to the incident following the attack. Shehab Wire's initial report did not provide a complete count of those injured in the strike or further details on the circumstances surrounding the operation.
